visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long braids, wearing an oversized grey t-shirt and black platform boots, stands in the aisle of a packed outdoor stadium at night. She smiles at the camera, holding two pink hammer-shaped lightsticks. The background shows thousands of audience members and a large stage screen displaying 'DEADLINE'. (2) The scene transitions to a high-energy stage performance. Four female pop idols in dark, stylized outfits dance in perfect synchronization. Multiple green laser beams crisscross the frame from the stage into the audience. Backstage musicians, including a guitarist, are visible in the dimly lit background behind the dancers. (3) The performance continues with high-intensity choreography. The stage lighting shifts to warm oranges and reds, complemented by thick white smoke. The background screen shows large Korean text while the dancers jump and gesture towards the crowd. The camera uses handheld zooming to create a dynamic, fan-captured feel.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A massive outdoor sports stadium filled with seating and an audience. The stage features large LED screens, professional rigging, laser machines, and smoke generators.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice is heard shouting a countdown '1, 2, 3' in English, followed by an explosive burst of cheering from a large crowd. The acoustic environment is a vast open-air stadium with significant natural reverb. There is a low-frequency hum from the sound system preparing for the track. (2) A high-tempo electronic dance music track kicks in with a powerful, synthesized kick drum and a driving bassline. A female voice shouts 'Jump!' with high arousal and authoritative tone. The crowd noise intensifies into a rhythmic roar that matches the beat of the music. (3) The BGM transitions into a structured pop song featuring melodic female vocals and sharp, percussive synth stabs. The mix is dense, with overlapping layers of high-frequency hi-hats and deep sub-bass. Occasional screams from nearby fans are captured by the microphone, adding to the live atmosphere.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Fan Hook -> Live Performance -> Peak Energy
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share the immersive and high-energy experience of attending a BLACKPINK concert, transitioning from the personal excitement of a fan to the spectacular stage production.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively captures the scale of a K-pop stadium tour using high-contrast lighting and synchronized audio-visual cues.
